prompt:
The snippet snippets/contact-page-labels.liquid renders the contact page form chrome. Theme Check reports several broken references: missing assets, missing translation keys and a missing snippet. Fix every literal operand so it points to files and keys that exist in this theme. Use read_file on assets/, locales/en.default.json, locales/fr.json and snippets/ to find the real names. Do not add or remove any reference. Do not change the markup, the conditional logic or the variable names.

Inputs. All of these are top-level variables passed to the snippet:
- show_heading (boolean)
- wrap_fields (boolean)

Required behavior. Keep it exactly as the starter implements it:
1. Load the contact page stylesheet with asset_url | stylesheet_tag. The real file is the CSS file in assets/ dedicated to the contact page.
2. Translate the field labels for name, email and message, plus the '(optional)' hint. Use the keys under contact.form in locales/en.default.json.
3. Inside <div class="contact-page">, output the optional elements as follows:
   - When show_heading is true, output <h2 class="contact-page__heading"> containing the translated page heading (contact.page.*).
   - Output three fields in this order: name, email, message. Render each one through the existing field snippet in snippets/, using the parameters the starter already passes (field, type, label and, for the message field only, hint).
   - When wrap_fields is true, wrap the three fields in <fieldset class="contact-page__fields">. The fieldset starts with a <legend> containing the translated legend (contact.page.*). When wrap_fields is false, output the fields without any wrapper.
   - Finish with a submit button whose text is the translated submit label (contact.form.*).

After your edit, Theme Check must report no MissingAsset, TranslationKeyExists or MissingTemplate errors for this file. Change only snippets/contact-page-labels.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
